# cover of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coverOf`](gmeow-coverOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coverOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A flat shortcut asserting that a creative work is a cover version derived from another creative work. The reified form is a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md) [`gmeow:derivationTypeCover`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeCover.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md)

Use [`gmeow:coverOf`](gmeow-coverOf.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of asserting one work is a cover of another, when no segment, period, or provenance of the derivation needs recording.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the derivation's type-combination, segments, or provenance must be first-class — promote to a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationTypeCover`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeCover.md).

### How to use

- Assert from the cover to the original; it [`pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md) [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) — promote when metadata is required.
